    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    phone_patches = image_patch.find("phone")
    
    if not man_patches or not phone_patches:
        return image_patch

    man_index = man_centers.index(closest_man)
    
    return man_patches[man_index]

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    board_patches = image_patch.find("board")
    
    if not man_patches or not board_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    board_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in board_patches]
    
    closest_man = min(man_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - board_centers[0]))
    man_idx = man_centers.index(closest_man)
    
    return man_patches[man_idx]

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    red_shirt_patches = image_patch.find("red shirt")
    
    if not man_patches or not red_shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    red_shirt_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in red_shirt_patches]
    
    closest_man = min(man_patches, key=lambda m: abs((m.left + m.right) / 2 - min(red_shirt_centers)))
    closest_red_shirt = min(red_shirt_patches, key=lambda r: abs((r.left + r.right) / 2 - closest_man.horizontal_center))
    
    return closest_red_shirt

modern_c1_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> str:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    if person_patches:
        person_patch = person_patches[0]
        gender = person_patch.simple_query("What is the gender?")
        age = person_patch.simple_query("How old is the person?")
        occupation = person_patch.llm_query(f"What does the {gender} person do for work?", long_answer=False)
        return f"The person is a {gender}, {age} years old, and works as a {occupation}."
    else:
        return "No person found in the image."
